zionism_def_1_label: Which of the following definitions is closest to how you would define the word "Zionism?" Check all that apply. A movement for self-determination and statehood for the Jewish people in their ancestral homeland
zionism_def_2_label: Which of the following definitions is closest to how you would define the word "Zionism?" Check all that apply. Support for the continued existence of Israel, in the face of calls for its destruction or dissolution
zionism_def_3_label: Which of the following definitions is closest to how you would define the word "Zionism?" Check all that apply. The belief that, if the other peoples of the world have a right to statehood, then the Jewish people have the same right
zionism_def_4_label: Which of the following definitions is closest to how you would define the word "Zionism?" Check all that apply. Establishing and maintaining a Jewish demographic majority in Palestine by driving out the native Palestinian population
zionism_def_5_label: Which of the following definitions is closest to how you would define the word "Zionism?" Check all that apply. The creation of a nation-state where Jews get more rights than others on the land
zionism_def_6_label: Which of the following definitions is closest to how you would define the word "Zionism?" Check all that apply. A form of racism and apartheid against Palestinians
zionism_def_7_label: Which of the following definitions is closest to how you would define the word "Zionism?" Check all that apply. None of the above
